Kosice Neologist Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Rastislavova 87, Slovakia

Demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'fenced and protected,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'yes.' Little further historical information is documented about the Jewish community of Košice. This, the Neologist Jewish cemetery, does not appear on an 1880s Austro-Hungarian map, though its oldest preserved tombstone, dated 1889, suggests it was founded no later than the late 19th century. It remains in active use today, divided between an older, larger section and a newer one.
